newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs jump to new highs, pork bellies higher.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs jump to new highs, pork bellies higher.

text.p: CME hog futures again moved higher on the open and quickly posted new contract highs in June through October while pork bellies advanced on carryover demand from word of Japan buying U.S. bellies, traders said.
Hog futures ran up on higher cash hog prices with June setting a new high of 84.150 cents per lb and July 83.750 cents. Bellies ran up on confirmation Japan was buying U.S. pork bellies, they said.
At 0915 CDT, hogs were up 0.500 to 0.050 cent a lb with June up 0.450 at 83.900 cents. Pork bellies were up 0.950 to 1.775 cents with May up 0.950 at 85.500 cents.
